title: expression-rna-tumor-vs-adjacent — result payload schema
description: Result payload that goes inside evidence.json's `result` field for the expression-rna-tumor-vs-adjacent product. One evidence.json per (gene, indication, subtype) tuple. Field names follow snake_case + semantic-prefix convention (tumor_vs_adjacent_*). Numeric fields stored at full precision; the rendered dossier rounds for display.

tumor_vs_adjacent_log2fc.description: DESeq2 log2 fold change, apeglm-shrunk. Positive = up in tumor.

tumor_vs_adjacent_lfc_se.description: Standard error of the shrunk log2 fold change.

tumor_vs_adjacent_pvalue.description: Wald-test p-value. Null when DESeq2 sets it to NA (independent filtering).

tumor_vs_adjacent_padj.description: BH-adjusted p-value (genome-wide, Tier 1). Null when filtered out.

tumor_vs_adjacent_basemean.description: Mean of normalized counts across all samples (DESeq2 baseMean).

n_tumor.description: Number of primary-tumor samples in the comparison.

n_normal.description: Number of adjacent-normal samples in the comparison.

is_significant.description: padj < 0.05 (Tier 1). Computed for convenience; downstream dossiers re-derive from padj.

is_actionable.description: padj < 0.05 AND |log2fc| >= 1. The 'actionability' threshold from the COADREAD config.

is_upregulated.description: padj < 0.05 AND log2fc > 0. True only if both significantly differentially expressed AND up in tumor.

tempus_summary.description: OPTIONAL — Tempus RWD overlay when the indication has Tempus coverage (e.g., COADREAD). Pre-aggregated per-stratum summary statistics. provenance.catalog_refs MUST cite the tempus source-release manifest (e.g., tempus-crc-2026-03-17) when this block is present.

pct_detected.description: Fraction of patients with detectable expression. RWD-specific signal — protein-coding genes typically >0.95; weakly expressed targets <0.5.

by_lot_mss.description: Stratified by line-of-therapy within MSS subset. Keys are LoT slugs (e.g., '1L-2L', '3L+'); values are summary objects matching `overall`.

by_ras_mss.description: Stratified by RAS mutation status within MSS subset.

by_msi.description: Stratified by microsatellite instability status (MSS vs MSI-H).

by_cms.description: Stratified by CRC Consensus Molecular Subtype (CMS1-4).

by_idas_group.description: Stratified by Takeda iDAS strategic whitespace tuples (e.g., 'MSS_RASMut_3L+'). Preserves whitespace labels verbatim — do NOT flatten.

$comment: Anchored to the coadread-dge-df06320 derived artifact's 11-column Parquet shape. The mapping from Parquet columns to evidence.json result keys: gene_symbol -> the artifact's natural row key (sidecar joins on it); log2FoldChange -> tumor_vs_adjacent_log2fc; lfcSE -> tumor_vs_adjacent_lfc_se; pvalue -> tumor_vs_adjacent_pvalue; padj -> tumor_vs_adjacent_padj; baseMean -> tumor_vs_adjacent_basemean; n_tumor, n_normal carry through; is_significant/is_actionable/is_upregulated carry through. The render-target-dossier skill is responsible for converting one Parquet row to one result-payload object.
